digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter transport layer
propositions: The DC transport must satisfy rebar's TicketTransport role and support links, comments, and absence probes without disturbing the existing Cloud/ACLI transport
pycontribs/jira must be confined to an opt-in [jira-datacenter] extra and imported lazily within functions to preserve 'import rebar' as dependency-free
PAT bearer auth is read from JIRA_PAT env-only; typed config for url/project must fail loudly on ConfigError rather than degrade to env-only
TLS validation must reject non-https base_url unless allow_insecure=true, and certificate verification must never be disabled regardless of allow_insecure setting
All TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, and SupportsAbsenceProbe methods require passing live tests against the J5 harness against a real Jira Data Center instance
The NameIdentity user-search resolver wire must be completed: it returns authoritative identity for real users and raises BackendAssigneeNotFoundError for unknown users
